title: USMCFP SPRINGFIELD-TREE FELLING SOLICITATION
agency: JUSTICE, DEPARTMENT OF > FEDERAL PRISON SYSTEM / BUREAU OF PRISONS > USMCFP SPRINGFIELD
description:
USMCFP SPRINGFIELD is looking to procure tree felling services for the grounds of the insitution. This is a one time award for felling decaying, damaged, or unwanted trees. The Statement of Work is at the bottom of the attached solicitation document and will contain details for the requirement. A site visit on 12-3-2026 at 8:00 a.m. Central Standard Time is   REQUIRED   to be considered for this award. Questions may be asked during the site visit, but they will be answered after the closing of questions stated below. Questions may be sent via email until time of closing posted below.  

 Schedule: 

 
	   REQUIRED   Site Vist 12-3-26 8:00a.m. CST

	 
		 Location: 1900 W Sunshine St. Springfield, MO Main Entrance  
		 Stop at the talk box in the main drive they will direct you to Visitor parking on the left. A representivite from the Facilities department will meet the contractors there.  
		 Please email dramsey1@bop.gov if you intend on participating in the site visit. This email is not required, however the site visit itself is required to be considered. The email allows us to provide adequate transportation during the site visit. 
	 
	 
	 Closing of questions 12-8-26 8:00a.m. CST 
	 Solicitation closes 12-10-26 8:00a.m. CST 
	 Performance Period will be within 60 days after date of award 
 

 For bid submission: 

 
	 Completed SF 1449 attached to the solicitation only pages 1-4 are required to be sent. 
	 Site Visit is required be considered for this requirement 
	 Bids must be submitted by 12-10-26 8:00 a.m. CST 
	 Bids must be within the specs specified in the solicitation 
	 Pricing will be per tree (estimated at 20 trees) 
 

 All bids and questions will be submitted to dramsey1@bop.gov.
